card.name: The word institutional and its relatives
card.fires_on: Responds to "institutional", "institution" or the start of "Instrument(ation)" and "Corpus" when they begin an organisation or policy term, such as Institutional Review Board or institutional protocols.

modes.label: Institutional review and policy
modes.description: The word institutional before review board, protocols or practices in study and clinical text.
modes.example: The study was reviewed and approved by the Johns Hopkins Bloomberg School of Public Health<< Institutional>> Review Board.

modes.label: Instrumentation as a company name
modes.description: The start of Instrumentation Laboratory, a maker of coagulation tests.
modes.example: HemosIL lyophilized silica tests from<< Instrument>>ation Laboratories.

modes.label: Institutional in general prose
modes.description: The word institutional in social or political writing, as in institutional prejudice or legitimacy.
modes.example: due to<< institutional>> prejudice, lack of provider and foster-parent
